title: A Road Nobody Rides
html:
Wispmeyer's supply wagons stopped coming after the last driver came back with the canvas cut open and wouldn't say why. Gregor Sr. wants the down road ridden and whatever's on it dealt with.

About

Given byGregor Sr.
Level25
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Gregor Sr. (outdoors near Wispmeyer) to get the quest.
  2. Ride the down road, the stretch nearest town at 900, -560
    Ride the down road, the middle stretch at 960, -440
    Ride the down road, the far stretch at 1010, -330
    Drive off the harpies nesting along the road (10)
  3. Report back to Gregor Sr. at 905, -698

Rewards

Reward
Gold270
Character XP10,800
Quest points1

What Gregor Sr. says

Gregor Sr.: Harpies. On the road.

Gregor Sr.: They nest on the down. Always have. And in thirty years they've never once come down to the road for a wagon.

You: What would they want with a wagon?

Gregor Sr.: Nothing. That's the whole of it. Flour and nails. There's nothing on a wagon a harpy wants.

Gregor Sr.: Something's moved them.

Gregor Sr.: Go south and talk to the peat-cutter. Penhallow. She notices things out there, and nobody ever asks her about any of them.

Handing it in

"Go south and talk to Penhallow. Something's moved them."
